subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 15, September 4th, 2026, The way out is not counted
body:

What degraded

  • The scanner's daily ceiling was NOT checked. The Supabase connector is installed and connected at the organisation level and is not enabled in this session, so the scans query could not be issued at all. Nobody is notified when a requester hits the cap, which is the whole reason that step exists. One switch in this session's connector settings clears it.
  • The record's geography backlog held steady at three rather than shrinking. All three are the named exemptions that predate the rule. tx-2026-0002 was considered and left alone, because it is a commission rulemaking for the ERCOT power region and `on_ercot` is a property rather than a place.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The way out is not counted, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Progreso is counted in one direction.

The federal count for Progreso in May 2026 is 101,306 pedestrians entering the United States. That is the month the Science and Technology Directorate brought three solutions to the bridge's exit area in Hidalgo County. The same dataset states that no comparable data is collected on outbound crossings.

The walk out got the cameras and no monthly count of its own. Signs in English and Spanish told United States citizens they could opt out and a lane was provided. The mandate the test serves applies to travelers who are not citizens. The account publishes no accuracy rate and no retention period for the images it judged suitable.

Dallas's Public Safety Committee takes up its Flock license plate readers on September 8th, 2026. Where does a pedestrian at Progreso go to ask?

#HidalgoCounty #ProgresoInternationalBridge #TravelerVerificationService

The record entry for this decision is at https://texasaidocket.com/item/tx-2026-0120/

101,306 is a count of pedestrians ENTERING the United States at Progreso in May 2026. It is not a count of the people the cameras watched, who were walking the other way. The dataset states that no comparable data is collected on outbound crossings.

Hidalgo County is not named on the Homeland Security page. It comes from the Census Bureau resolving the port of entry's own published coordinates, which is claim c27.

The Dallas briefing on September 8th, 2026 is a different program in a different city. The account announces no comment window and no hearing on the Progreso test.

The machine changed itself

  • New gate `scripts/carousel/verbatim_check.py`.
    Measured on this run's own artifacts. `IT DID JUST THAT` was in no claim quote at all. `HIGH QUALITY IMAGES` dropped `facial` out of c9's `high-quality facial images`, in a verbatim slot, beside a real quotation. `MARYLAND, ROOFED` and `PROGRESO, OPEN SKY` were physical assertions about two real places and the second contradicted the deck's own frame 1. `CARRIL DE CAPTURA` and `CARRIL DE EXCLUSION
  • `scripts/carousel/panel_ready.py` measures the deck's value arc against the plan the storyboard declares, and refuses to call the deck scorable when the deck median L* misses its own planned median by more than one Munsell value step..
    out/2026-09-04/measurements.json records it. The first render of carousel 15 measured deck median 6.3 against a plan of 24, with eight of nine frames between 4.5 and 10.1, which is not a dark deck but an unlit one. It was found by the showrunner writing a one-off measure.py AFTER three judges had been spawned on it, which is precisely what panel_ready exists to prevent. Every prior deck missed its
  • `scripts/carousel/dedupe_check.py` prints every `angle_note` inside the ledger's own window, first, before its own verdict, whether or not anything else fires.
    ledger/carousel/topics.json, deck 14's angle_note: `FOURTH DECK IN SEVEN BUILT ON WHAT A DOCUMENT DOES NOT SAY... THE NEXT RUN SHOULD PICK A STORY WHERE SOMETHING HAPPENED, not one where a document is quiet.` Deck 11's said the same thing about opening moves. Carousel 15's angle is that a document is quiet, the fifth in eight, and both round 1 judges named it. Three consecutive notes, 2026-08-26,
  • scripts/carousel/shipped_check.py: the word-number allowlist read only the TOP LEVEL of computed.json and every computed.json in this repo nests its figures under `values`.
    The set was empty on every deck but one, and on 2026-09-03 it was {14} because that file happened to carry a top level "deck": 14. It went unseen because an empty allowlist makes the gate STRICTER, so a run that hit it reworded its own prose and cleared the finding without touching the cause. Calibrated on the real shipped run: 'five' now clears because compute.py computes it, and 'seventeen' still goes red.
  • scripts/site/site_pages/editorial.py: an article whose first sentence is short and whose second overflows shipped a description under the SEO band.
    This deck opened on a 32 character hook followed by a 230 character dek, so the article page's description was the hook alone and seo_check refused the build. The loop preferred a sentence boundary and, when one was unreachable, kept nothing. It now takes a word boundary out of the overflowing sentence, but only when stopping would leave the description under the band.

Each reverts on its own commit.

Notes

[ "THE DECK SHIPPED UNDER THE BAR. Panel 6.678 against 6.8, which is 0.122 short, with NO hard fail from any of the three judges in the final round. That is the cap's own rule rather than a run talking itself past a gate: max_rounds bounds the search, not the standard, and a hard fail still stops a deck at any round. Both judges who scored under the bar said in as many words that their no was the number and not a fault.", "THE ROUND COUNTER READS 6 AND TWO OF THOSE ARE THIS RUN'S OWN COMBINE ERRORS. The judges return their report cards in their results rather than writing score-<lens>.json, so twice the first panel.py call read the PREVIOUS round's files still sitting on disk and printed a verdict for a round already scored. The second time it mixed one fresh card with two stale ones and reported SHIP at 6.858. Neither entry was deleted, because count_round() is the length of a file precisely so a run under pressure can't write a smaller number in a field. The cost is two rounds of headroom.", "TWELVE REPAIRS LANDED AFTER THE LAST REPORT CARD and the score reflects none of them. Each is a defect a round 4 judge named and verified: frame 9's blanked opening still read as a plinth because the previous fix changed value where the defect was geometry, frame 9's upper axis was cut by its own label chip and never reached the aperture it terminates on, frame 7's plate contradicted the falloff its own drums had just been given, frame 4's dossier declared one dimension line where the render draws two, and the caption had none of the deck's one fact that costs a real person something. They are listed one by one in the run record.", "THE NEW GATE FOUND SOMETHING ON ITS FIRST LIVE RUN. verbatim_check, built by this run's own upgrade lane, noticed that frame 4's MARYLAND TEST FACILITY is a literal fragment of a claim's quote while BUILT FIRST and THE ORIGINAL sat in the SAME rendered style tracing to no claim. That is the deck's own words wearing the slot a quotation anchors, and it is the milder form of the defect that killed frame 4's first construction. The two place names keep the plate and the two annotations are unplated now.", "THE VARIETY DEBTS ARE UNPAID AT THE NUMBER THEY WERE RECORDED AT. Deck 13 said the plate primitive was carrying five of nine frames and it still is. Deck 14 said seven of nine frames run one type skeleton and they still do. Deck 14's angle_note said in capitals to pick a story where something happened, and this is the fifth deck in eight built on what a document does not say. The run read that field after the deck was built, which is why dedupe_check now prints those notes before its own verdict.", "THE FACT CHECK FILED FIVE API RESPONSES AS OFFICIAL RECORDS. data.transportation.gov, webapi.legistar.com and geocoding.geo.census.gov are datasets, and the claims vocabulary has a word for that. Nothing failed, because claims_check accepts either. The cost would have been this email reporting 32 official records and 0 data records as a fact about how the deck was sourced. It is 27 and 5.", "dhs.gov RETURNED 403 TO curl AND 200 TO WebFetch on the same URL in the same minute. The article this whole deck rests on is unreachable by the tool a session reaches for first. A scout with only curl would have reported that the story does not exist." ]

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
